Targeted pass of a 986-page BREF (TOC and lists of tables; Ch.2.3-2.7 energy generation and efficiency; Ch.3.2.3 efficiency techniques; Ch.4.3.1 gasification economics; Ch.5.1.2-5.1.3 coal/lignite efficiencies; Ch.6.2.2; Ch.7.1.2, 7.1.3, 7.2; Ch.9.2.3; Ch.10 BAT conclusions energy-efficiency tables; Ch.11 emerging techniques). Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 44; PDF p.548 has no printed number, inferred 504). Main file: every BAT-AEEL energy-efficiency table (Tables 10.2, 10.8, 10.13, 10.17, 10.21, 10.23, 10.27, 10.28, 10.33, 10.42), split per row into a power side (net electrical efficiency, new and existing unit; recorded as efficiency/target electricity, mapped to steam-turbine_condensing, combustion-turbine_simple-cycle, reciprocating-engine_diesel-generator or the proposed combined-cycle) and a CHP side (net total fuel utilisation, recorded as efficiency-chp, mapped to steam-turbine_back-pressure, reciprocating-engine_chp or combustion-turbine_heat-recovery-steam-generator); net mechanical efficiency of OCGT drives (combustion-turbine_drive). BAT-AEELs are LHV, full load, net at unit boundary, not for units < 1 500 h/yr. Also: GT shaft efficiencies (Table 2.2), energetic efficiency examples incl. industrial CHP (Table 2.4), heat rates of cogeneration and heat-only boilers converted to efficiencies (Table 3.36, formula column), solid-fuel and liquid-fuel boiler efficiencies (Sect. 5.1.2.2, 6.2.2), design efficiencies of example coal/lignite plants (Tables 5.10, 5.11, 5.29, 5.30), ISO efficiencies of gas units (Table 7.2), biogas GT (Table 7.19), engine CHP heat-to-power, recuperated GT, Gussing gasifier CHP, Kymijarvi gasifier cost, IGCC capex, 700 degC coal plant, amine capture rate. Not loaded: pollutant BAT-AELs, abatement-technique costs (SCR, FGD, ESP etc.), water, residues, noise; operating (yearly average) efficiencies of Table 7.3 and DH rows of Table 3.36 to other-values; efficiency figures shown only as charts (Figures 5.12-5.25, 6.1, 7.5-7.22, 7.49-7.50) not read. Very few whole-technology costs exist in this BREF; those found have no price year. Technology names carry new-unit / existing-unit / new-or-existing variants because BAT-AEELs differ by vintage; one example per table row and side.
